_comment: Optional. Copy to ~/.claude/nba-scores-mod.json and keep only the fields you want to change. Pick your team and language with /config instead.
_spoilerFree_comment: Hide the score of finished games until you click Reveal.
_log_comment: Write one line per fetch to ~/.claude/nba-scores-mod.<start time>.log. For debugging only.
_date_comment: Pin the band to one day (YYYYMMDD). For development during the off-season.
